observation: Fresh main already validates writer-format timestamps, but its apply writer sets updatedAt and applyReceipt.at from the same value and its rollback writer sets updatedAt and rollbackReceipt.at from the same value while the durable read boundary accepted independently rewritten canonical timestamps. A durable artifact could therefore preserve valid date-time syntax yet contradict the lifecycle write that produced its current state.
changes: Bind APPLIED applyReceipt.at to the current updatedAt value at the shared durable receipt lifecycle boundary.
Bind ROLLED_BACK rollbackReceipt.at to the current updatedAt value at the same boundary.
Do not invent broader temporal ordering, clock trust or cross-machine causality policy.
